meta.name: Gina Yei
meta.description: Yei!— Is what Gina says in positive situations or simply whenever she is happy. She has won a scholarship to the prestigious Caribbean Music Institute (CMI) on the island of Puerto Rico, the best place in the world to study Latin music and the birthplace of the successful reggaeton thanks to her lyric-writing abilities. Gina is a cheerful, energetic, and creative girl who loves writing. Her ultimate dream is to write songs.

videos.title: Influencers and Models
videos.overview: Valentina comes up with the idea of starting a beachwear campaign. Jayden and Manu want to leave the school.

videos.title: Two by Two
videos.overview: Isabel wants Gina and Ruby to form a duo. Gina is sad because Manu wants to leave the school.

videos.title: Made for You
videos.overview: Jayden and Manu continue with their duo. Luis Diego gets involved with Vero and Amy. Valentina wants to find out if Rocío and Mr. One are together.

videos.title: Lyrics and Music
videos.overview: Rocío admits that she was with Mr. One. "I Keep Thinking About You" is Jayden and Manu's new hit song.

videos.title: Tell Me Who You're With
videos.overview: \Mr. One gets Hansel expelled from school. Gina decides to talk to Jayden about the kiss between him and Lucía.

videos.title: Secrets and Resignations
videos.overview: Lucía decides to team up with Ruby and the Jewels. Gina confesses to her mother that she is confused between Jayden and Manu.

videos.title: The Return of the Rings
videos.overview: Ruby tells Manu that Gina and Jayden kissed. Hansel proposes to Mr. One the return of the "Golden Rings."

videos.title: The Mermaid Is Sad
videos.overview: Jayden asks Gina if she wants to be his girlfriend. Manu confronts them both breaks up with Gina and also ends his friendship with Jayden.

videos.title: One Is Enough
videos.overview: Jayden and Manu fight and Gina tries to stop them. Mystery "D" reappears and steals the three Golden Rings.

videos.title: Tell Me Who You're With
videos.overview: Jayden and Ruby plan to compete separately. Cassandra hires a hacker to alter the voting results.

videos.title: The First Battle
videos.overview: The "Golden Rings" competition continues. Manu is heartbroken and Gina can't believe that Manu broke up with her again.

videos.title: The Singer Is Me
videos.overview: Salvador tells Gina that he is her father Aurora confesses that she is "Mystery D" and also Gina's sister... Gina and Manu reunite and decide to be together again with all their hearts and more!
